exercise.title: Hum, then open
exercise.why: Humming keeps the sound small and easy to tune, so opening to "oo" from a hum carries the in-tune note with it.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below to start the drone and the mic. Hum the low {{1}} with your lips closed, then open it to "oo" on the same note.
Then skip up to {{5}} the same way: hum it first, then open.
_Don't reach for high notes: {{5}} here is the one just above the low {{1}}._
